decisions.title: Palette and surfaces
decisions.question: Which colour base? The chrome (header band and sidebars) is a step away from the page in every option.

options.label: nexus10 tokens + border.strong
options.desc: Today's theme.toml values (neutral #0B0B0B page, warm amber accent), plus a decorative border.strong for modal frames. Contrast-checked.

options.label: Old Nexus 'Grok Night'
options.desc: Old Nexus palette: flatter #141414 surfaces, peach accent #fab283, lighter muted text. Softer, lower contrast.

options.label: A, with a cool focus colour
options.desc: As A, but focus bars and rings use a cool blue so focus is never confused with the accent (answers the PLAN.md open question).

decisions.title: Shell frame and header
decisions.question: How is the window framed, and where do the tabs and title go?

options.label: Chrome band
options.desc: The header band and both sidebars share one chrome surface around the page. The tab icons sit in the band over the sidebar. The breadcrumb is aligned with the page, and the run status is on the right.

options.label: Old tab strip
options.desc: Old Nexus: open sessions as tabs across the top, with a location row under them (~/repos/nexus · main) and Idle on the right.

options.label: Today
options.desc: A header row floating on the canvas, with the tabs in the sidebar's first row.

options.label: Two-line rows by project
options.desc: A mark slot (◆ waiting, ◐ running, ✕ error, ● unread), the title and time, then agent (in its colour) · ⌥ branch and the child count. Grouped by project and worktree. The open session has a selection band; focus is a bar.

options.label: Status groups (old sessions page)
options.desc: One line per session, grouped under Needs you / Working / Idle headings, with the age on the right.

options.label: Today
options.desc: Two-line rows with no status marks and no grouping.

decisions.title: User message
decisions.question: How does a user message (the turn header) look?

options.label: Full-bleed band
options.desc: A raised band across the whole page with a muted rail (accent when focused), the fold marker inside, #2 · time on the right and a padding row above and below. Includes a sticky copy when scrolled.

options.label: Inset card (old Nexus)
options.desc: A card inset by 2 cells with no rail, and the tag on the right. Closest to the old screenshots.

options.label: Today
options.desc: An inset block with the fold marker hanging outside it in the gutter.

decisions.title: Turn footer
decisions.question: Where do a turn's model, duration, tokens and status go?

options.label: Right-aligned, end of turn
options.desc: ▪ Build · model · effort · tools · 4.2s · tokens · cost · ✓ done, right-aligned with no rule (old Nexus).

options.label: Left, under a hairline
options.desc: The current INTERFACE_PLAN spec: one muted row below a full-width hairline, left-aligned.

options.label: Today
options.desc: '<1 s · 3 tools   ✓ done' above a rule. It reads as the next turn's header.

decisions.title: Tool activity
decisions.question: How should tool calls and activity groups look?

options.label: Verb glyph tree
options.desc: Folded summaries with failures visible. A live 'Working' header with a shimmer and the newest 5 members as a tree. Members have verb glyphs (→ Read, ← Edit, $ Shell, * Search). The old Nexus detail box opens with ┌ │ ╰.

options.label: Status glyphs only
options.desc: The same structure, but each member shows only its status glyph (✓ ◐ ✕) instead of a verb glyph. Quieter, but you lose the at-a-glance verb.

options.label: Today
options.desc: ▸ Ran 1 command, Read 1 file. The members are plain rows.

options.label: Thought for 2.1s · preview
options.desc: Old Nexus code style: ▸ Thought for 2.1s, plus the first summary line in italic. While running: Thinking… with the last 5 rows behind ┃.

options.label: ◇ preview line
options.desc: Old Nexus screenshot style: ◇ and the italic first line with ▸ at the end, and the duration on a separate line.

decisions.title: Markdown and code fences
decisions.question: How do code fences and inline code look?

options.label: Panel block with a header row
options.desc: A panel block with the language on the left and 'c copy' on the right, with no rule and no rail. Inline code is primary on panel, never accent.

options.label: Today
options.desc: A language label, a ──── rule and a │ rail. Inline code is in the accent colour.

options.label: Split when wide, unified when narrow
options.desc: Side by side (old Nexus) when the reading column is at least 110 cells, with a ╱ hatch on the empty side. Unified below that.

options.label: Always unified
options.desc: One layout everywhere: unified with line numbers and tints.

decisions.title: New session and starting context
decisions.question: What does a new session show before the first message?

options.label: Context sections
options.desc: A header block (agent, model, directory, keys), then ◆ sections with token counts, preview lines and a tools grid. After the first turn it folds to one line.

options.label: Inverted label chips (old Nexus)
options.desc: Old screenshot style: System prompt / Tools / AGENTS.md as filled label chips with ~tokens, and the body indented.

options.label: Today
options.desc: A key/value list, then centred 'New session' help text.

decisions.title: Composer
decisions.question: How does the composer card look?

options.label: Soft card (old Nexus)
options.desc: A panel card with half-row edges, the cursor on the placeholder's first letter, Agent · model · effort on the left and the ╱ meter on the right. A live Working row while busy. The project strip sits below.

options.label: Card with a focus rail
options.desc: Full-row padding and a ▌ rail on the left that turns accent when focused, with a ━ bar meter.

options.label: Today
options.desc: A flat panel, with an accent underline under the location strip that renders as dashes.

decisions.title: Right sidebar
decisions.question: How is session information laid out?

options.label: SESSION / CONTEXT / GIT sections
options.desc: Uppercase muted labels, a key/value grid, the context meter, tokens and cost, and Git groups with +N −M.

options.label: Tabbed details (old Nexus)
options.desc: A tab row (Session, Changes, Git, Jobs) with one section at a time. More room per section, but more clicks.

options.label: Today
options.desc: ▾ Session info as lower-case key/value rows, with clipped values.

decisions.title: Overlays: palette, settings and pickers
decisions.question: How do modals look, and how is the selected row marked?

options.label: Framed over a scrim, selection band
options.desc: A rounded border.strong frame on raised, over a dimmed scrim. The title and esc sit in the border. The selected row has a selection band and focus bar, and section headings are UPPERCASE muted.

options.label: Accent-filled row, violet headings
options.desc: Today's Settings recipe applied to every modal, but framed and scrimmed: the selected row is fully filled with the accent and headings are violet.

options.label: Today
options.desc: Settings is unframed with an accent fill. The palette is framed, but nothing underneath is dimmed.

decisions.title: Waiting card (approval and question)
decisions.question: How are the choices presented when the agent waits for you?

options.label: Key-chip list (old Nexus)
options.desc: ◆ Allow bash?, waiting on you · 0:42, the parameters, then one choice per row with a key chip (y a n m) and a selected ▸.

options.label: Button row
options.desc: INTERFACE_PLAN sketch: [ allow once ] [ allow session ] [ deny ] [ deny with note ] on one row, with key hints below.

decisions.title: Toasts, banners and jump to latest
decisions.question: Where do transient alerts appear?

options.label: Top-right of the page (old Nexus)
options.desc: Toasts under the header, top-right, with a level bar and a lifetime hairline. A banner at the top of the page. A jump-to-latest pill above the composer.

options.label: Bottom-right, above the composer
options.desc: The INTERFACE_PLAN position. Closer to where you type, but competes with the composer and the jump pill.

options.label: Tree with guides, file view with gutter
options.desc: Indent guides, coloured Git letters and a root header with the branch. The file view has a path header, a line gutter and a bottom search row.

options.label: Today
options.desc: A flat tree. The file view has a centred path header.

options.label: Drawers below 100 columns
options.desc: The centre only, with sidebars as drawers over a scrim. The composer sheds effort, then the provider, then the meter.

options.label: Today
options.desc: Today at 80×24.

decisions.title: Empty, offline and loading
decisions.question: What do the empty and error states look like?

options.label: Wordmark and plain sentences
options.desc: A half-block NEXUS wordmark (from the old splash) with the next step and its key. Offline: a banner, ✕ offline in the header and an editable composer.

options.label: Today
options.desc: Today's empty workspace.
